patterns: APPSC asks single-fact items: fastest medium = optical fibre (APPSC 2025), 5G hackathon organiser (DoT), EMF limits (APPSC 2021).
Most filed PYQs are physics of EM waves/TIR: optical fibre = total internal reflection, IR = remote controls/night vision, longest/shortest wavelength ordering.
Li-Fi/VLC, Bluetooth vs Wi-Fi (2.4 GHz) and WiMAX recur as one-liners.
App MCQs lean heavily on 2026 current-affairs numbers (TRAI bands, Gati Shakti, labs) in long statement sets; PYQs are far shorter and more conceptual.
